Anga bi'sa chonenga, Ka'sanisan ong'enga, Ka'onangako angan, Jakkalrongjawa pangnan. Namgipanu nangringen, Tol'gipako mitchigen; Miknenggipa bi'sako Rorimja anga uko.
NIa'na pa'na ka'sagen, U'mangko manironggen.
Bi'saskan' manengoba, Inchakjawa ukoba.
Ang' jong aro norangko, Ka'sae dilgen u'mangko, Gipin ripengrangnaba, Ka'sagen u'mangnaba.
--- Page 6 --- GAROREADERI Lesson Jegrika Changsao mande sakgni ‘Ua matchu bima angnisa' ine jegrike salsekgrikna a'bachengaha.

Indiba uamangni indake, saksa grongo aro sak- gipin ki'meo rim'e, salsekgrikmitingon, sakgipin mandesa ua matchu bimani sokko sepe ra'- angtokaha. Mandcrangni gisepo jegrikaniara uandaken bon'kamronga.
Uni gimin an'ching jegrikna nangja.
--- Page 7 --- GARO READERI Lesson Singho aro Matchok Changsao okkrigipa singho nangsa tusibeeng- gipa mnangsa sapauko nikaha.
Arouauko chagopc rim'nasiengachim.
Ua uochachan dal'bc- gipa katpakangenggipa mangsa matchokko nike ua sapauko dongalemung matchokko rikangskaha. Singhoni rikangani gam'ako knae sapau inikrake- mung gipinchina katangaha.
Singho matchokko sal gimik neng'bee rikangahaoba srapjajok.
Uni gimin ua neng:a aro okkria amjae, gisiktango indine chanchiaha, ‘Anga angni dongalbagimin sapaukon cha'e.
rosranggcn.' Singho, sapauni tusiram biapona pil'baaha.
Indiba re'bae nion sapauko nikejajok, maina uan katangsoahachim.

--- Page 8 --- GAROREADERI Manderang basakobade an'tangtangni jako man'giminko chonnika; aro uamang an'tangtangni man'gijana mikboke uko man'na joton ka'ronga; aro indaken an'tangtangni man'giminkon basako- bade gimaatsranga. An'ching an'tangtangni jako man'giminko chu'ongnikna aro dal'nikna nanga.
Lesson 4 Do'drang Pilak do'on ku'sik apsan ong'ja.
Badiaba badi- aba do'oni ku'sik ro'a, gitok ro'a, aro ja'teng ro'a.
Indake maina ong'a?
Badiaba badiaba do'o dipoo cha'ama. Uni gimin uarang ku'sik, gitok aro ja'teng ro'ako nanga.
Do'gep aro do'nokni ja'a dingtanga.
Do'gepni ja'a chio.jrona nama.
--- Page 9 --- GAROREADERI Lesson 5 Gorial Ding'gipa a'songni chibimarango gorial hang'- bea.
An'chingni a'songoba Songdu chibimao bang'a.
Gorial sal ding'ao an'chengo salbarama. Ia noksao an'ching salbaramenggipa gorialko nika.
Ua ku'siktangko ku'ange chio napnasienga.
Manggipinko rikna mangsongengakon.: Basako- bade gorialrang tom'dake an'chengo salbarama.
--- Page 10 --- GAROREADERI Lesson Gisik Grigipa Do'bok Manggni Badiaba a'songni badiaba biapo chi ta'rake jokgipa aro chikol tu'gipa chiring dilsa gnang- chim.
Ua chiringni apchongipa biap damsao chim. Ua jal'ang apchonani gimin uko malgiparang jatchio gronggrikode watpakgrikna manjachin.
Changsao gisik grigipa do'bok manggni nalsagrik- oni ua jal'angko malbae uni jatchio gronggrikaha.
Uarang gaora de'gipa aro bamgrikgijagipa ong'- achim.
Uni gimin manggnioni mangsaba an'pilna sikjaha.
Indaken mangsara manggipinna an'tangko
